text:
Alex: FYI: Vendor (StrataCloud) scheduled maintenance for us-west-2 on Thu 03:00-05:00 UTC. They flagged potential node reboots that could reduce capacity in our private racks. Need a quick plan for Dedicated pools + canaries. @Samira can you check pool spillover config? :eyes:
Samira: Looking. If nodes go down we should route traffic to eu-west1 and fallback to lower-capacity model variants. Are we comfortable with latency hit? Also what's our spare capacity in Redwood Dedicated west pool?
Raj: I can check quotas and reserved nodes. Running `rbctl pool list --region us-west2 --fields name,size,spare` now.
oncall-bot: Automated: Scheduled maintenance detected for vendor/stratacloud/us-west-2 at 2026-03-20T03:00Z. Predicted reduced capacity: 25-40% for 2h.
Maria: @Alex can we shift canaries earlier? Also prefer non-overlapping with nightly batch jobs (runs 02:00-03:30).
Samira: rbctl output: west-dedicated: size=120 GPUs, spare=6; west-private: size=48 GPUs, spare=0; eu-dedicated spare=20. We can't absorb full 48 -> need cross-region routing + model capping.
Alex: Ok plan: 1) Move canaries to eu-west1 for the window 03:00-06:00 UTC. 2) Temporarily reduce quality to quantized-8 for non-critical routes. 3) Toggle spillover to dedicated eu and enable request throttling for low-tier API keys. @vendor-liaison can you confirm Stratacloud will give 5min warning before reboots?
vendor-liaison: Confirmed — we'll get a 10-min warning via webhook. Also we can request live drain on specific racks if you need 30-min buffer.
Raj: I'll open the routing PR and add a canary schedule. Assigning to @Samira for config changes. PR link: https://git.re/redwood/infra/pulls/4521 (WIP).
Samira: Will add fallback model mapping + throttles. Quick Q: do we want to block heavy batch infer jobs cross-region during window? Those are the ones that push us over EU spare.
Maria: Yes block non-urgent batch jobs between 03:00-05:30 UTC. I'll update the job-scheduler policy.
Alex: :thumbsup: Good. @oncall-bot please create an incident post (planned-maintenance) for the window and notify ENG-SRE + Customer Success.
oncall-bot: Created incident: INC-20260320-17. Notifying channels: eng-sre, customer-success. ETA 10min warning webhook is set to the ops webhook.
Raj: I'll also increase instance pool autoscale buffer from 2->3 nodes for us-west2 to try and keep critical services. Might spin a couple spare H100s from reserved accounts.
Samira: Note: upscaling will take ~8-12 min per instance. We'll rely on prewarm images. I'll add a runbook step in the PR.
Maria: Thanks everyone. I'll send a customer-facing note to any P0 customers in us-west2.
Alex: If anything changes ping here.
